about: Derived, sanitized evidence for canvas MR !1955 CI timeline. All times UTC. Raw API responses and job logs are not published; job logs were reduced to Playwright result counts, test titles and artifact-upload 502 counts.
sources: GET .../merge_requests/1955/pipelines (paginated, 4 pipelines; no fork branch pipelines)
GET /projects/19391/pipelines?ref=1.x and jobs for baseline pipelines

method.queued: pending_at = started_at − queued_duration (GitLab: time pending for a runner). Waiting for earlier stages (status "created") is not counted as queue.
method.running: started_at → finished_at per executed attempt (GitLab duration).
method.any_job_running: Length of the union of all running intervals across all pipelines; parallel jobs are counted once.
method.queued_only: Union of queued intervals minus the running union: some job waited for a runner while none ran.
method.no_job_queued_or_running: Window minus the union of queued and running intervals. Covers review, retry decisions, rebases and time a pipeline sat with only failed/manual jobs.
method.runner_time_sum: Sum of every attempt’s run time; parallel jobs add up, so it exceeds wall-clock.
method.targeted_retries: Per pipeline and job name: attempts − 1 (jobs API include_retried=true). Playwright’s own in-job retries (playwright.config.ts retries: 3 on CI) are separate and are not counted here.
method.excluded: Manual jobs never started (51 per pipeline in the last two) and jobs canceled before starting.
